0022600035.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-10, 0-5 on the road, losers of seven straight) visit the Orlando Magic (3-7, on a one-game winning streak), with Milwaukee 15th in the East and Orlando 11th. Milwaukee is without Myles Turner (rest), while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bucks lost the season series 1-2, including a 130-91 loss in Milwaukee on March 8, 2026.
